about: Shared vectors of the device key (plan B): spki is the public key (SPKI DER, base64url), message the 32 bytes that were signed (hex), signature the r||s of 64 bytes as WebCrypto gives it (base64url), valid whether it verifies. Produced with WebCrypto ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 (Node) and checked there; read by Pest (tests/Unit/WorkerAccess/DeviceKeyCryptoTest.php) and by Vitest (the app's signBytes, commit 19).

vectors.name: r_with_high_bit
vectors.description: The first byte of r is 0x80 or more: DER needs a 0x00 in front of it.

vectors.name: s_with_leading_zero
vectors.description: The first byte of s is 0x00: DER drops it.

vectors.name: altered_signature
vectors.description: The first vector with one bit of s changed: well formed, does not verify.
